package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.external

import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.Target
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures.StoreFixtures
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.graph.*
import java.util.ArrayDeque

private fun quote(s: String): String = "\"" + s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"") + "\""
private fun json(x: Any?): String = when (x) {
    null -> "null"
    is String -> quote(x)
    is Boolean, is Number -> x.toString()
    is Map<*, *> -> x.entries.joinToString(",", "{", "}") { quote(it.key.toString()) + ":" + json(it.value) }
    is Iterable<*> -> x.joinToString(",", "[", "]") { json(it) }
    else -> error("JSON")
}
private class Output : LocalRelationOut {
    val data = ArrayList<Facts>()
    val requests = ArrayList<Int>()
    val targets = ArrayList<String>()
    override fun data(original: PremiseKey, value: Facts) { data += value }
    override fun target(original: PremiseKey, target: Target) { targets += target.toString() }
    override fun markRequest(mark: TaintMark) { requests += mark.id }
}
fun main() {
    val f = StoreFixtures()
    val ap = f.manager
    val ops = f.ops
    val p = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(23)
    val q = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(18)
    val a = f.field("f")
    val b = f.field("g")
    val c = f.field("h")
    val d = f.field("k")
    val t = f.mark("T")
    val u = f.mark("U")
    val mx = MarkExclusions.of(ap.marks, listOf(t, u))
    val mode = ApMode(false, Direction.BACKWARD, 8)
    val application = LocalRelationApplication(ops, mode)
    val paths = listOf(listOf(a), listOf(a,b), listOf(a,b,c), listOf(d))
    fun desc(value: Facts): Map<String, Any?> = linkedMapOf("layer" to value.layer.name,
        "rows" to ops.leaves(value).map { pattern -> linkedMapOf("base" to pattern.fact.base.toString(),
            "path" to pattern.fact.path, "tail" to pattern.fact.tail.name,
            "E" to (pattern.exclusion as? ExclusionSet.Concrete)?.ids?.toList().orEmpty(),
            "mark" to when (val mark = pattern.fact.mark) {
                is MarkSlot.Star -> linkedMapOf("kind" to "FLOW", "mx" to mark.excluded.ids.toList())
                is MarkSlot.Concrete -> linkedMapOf("kind" to "CONCRETE", "id" to mark.mark.id)
            }) }.toList())
    val controls = ArrayList<Map<String, Any?>>()
    for (must in listOf(false,true)) {
        val oldTail = if (must) Tail.ANY_TAINT else Tail.STAR
        val oldInitial = ap.initial(f.pattern(p, listOf(c,d), oldTail, MarkSlot.STAR))
        var packed: Facts? = null
        for (path in paths) {
            val piece = f.fact(q, path, oldTail, MarkSlot.Star(mx))
            packed = packed?.let { ap.mergeAddDelta(it,piece).first } ?: piece
        }
        val leaves = ops.leaves(checkNotNull(packed)).toList()
        val views = leaves.map { checkNotNull(reverseRecordLeaf(Direction.FORWARD, oldInitial.toPattern(), Conclusion(it.fact,it.exclusion,false))) }
        for (name in listOf("ancestor-normal-STAR","ancestor-DEMAND-ANY","at-first-output-STAR","ancestor-STAR-excluding-f")) {
            val actualPath = if (name == "at-first-output-STAR") listOf(a) else emptyList()
            val actualTail = if (name == "ancestor-DEMAND-ANY") Tail.ANY else Tail.STAR
            val actualLayer = if (actualTail == Tail.ANY) Layer.DEMAND else Layer.NORMAL
            val actualE = if (name == "ancestor-STAR-excluding-f") ExclusionSet.of(a) else ExclusionSet.Empty
            val actual = f.fact(q, actualPath, actualTail, MarkSlot.STAR, actualE, actualLayer)
            val original = ap.initial(f.pattern(q, actualPath, actualTail, MarkSlot.STAR, actualE))
            val outputs = ArrayList<Map<String, Any?>>()
            val strict = ArrayList<Pair<Boolean,Facts>>()
            val allResults = ArrayList<Facts>()
            val untouchedResults = ArrayList<Facts>()
            for ((i,view) in views.withIndex()) {
                val out = Output()
                val applied = application.applyRecordView(actual,original,view,false,out)
                check(out.requests.isEmpty() && out.targets.isEmpty())
                val ancestor = view.premise.fact.path.size > actualPath.size && view.premise.fact.path.take(actualPath.size) == actualPath
                val grows = loopFieldLength(Pattern(view.result.fact,view.result.exclusion)) > loopFieldLength(view.premise)
                outputs += linkedMapOf("ordinal" to i,"storedOutputPath" to leaves[i].fact.path,
                    "strictAncestor" to ancestor,"applied" to applied,"grows" to grows,"results" to out.data.map(::desc))
                allResults += out.data
                if (ancestor) for (value in out.data) strict += grows to value else untouchedResults += out.data
            }
            val byGrowth = strict.groupBy { it.first }.mapValues { (_,values) -> values.map { it.second }.distinct() }
            check(byGrowth.values.all { it.size <= 1 })
            val groupedPure = strict.map { it.second }.distinct()
            check((untouchedResults+groupedPure).toSet() == allResults.toSet())
            if (name.startsWith("ancestor-") && name != "ancestor-STAR-excluding-f") {
                check(strict.size == 4 && groupedPure.size == 1 && byGrowth.keys == setOf(false,true))
            }
            if (name == "at-first-output-STAR") {
                check(strict.size == 2)
                if (!must) check(allResults.map { it.layer }.toSet() == setOf(Layer.NORMAL,Layer.DEMAND))
            }
            if (name == "ancestor-STAR-excluding-f") check(strict.size == 1)
            controls += linkedMapOf("kind" to if (must) "FLOW-MUST reverse view" else "generic STAR reverse view",
                "case" to name,"oldPremise" to oldInitial.toString(),"actual" to desc(actual),"views" to outputs,
                "nativeResultCount" to allResults.size,"strictAncestorResultCount" to strict.size,
                "pureObserverDistinctConstantResults" to groupedPure.size,
                "actualReplayGrowthStrata" to byGrowth.map { (g,vs) -> linkedMapOf("grows" to g,"distinctResults" to vs.size) },
                "outsideCellRetained" to untouchedResults.map(::desc))
        }
    }
    // AP-level fixed-point mechanism only: existing NORMAL rows, not an analyzer run.
    val zero = f.field("bit0")
    val one = f.field("bit1")
    val closureCases = ArrayList<Map<String, Any?>>()
    for (length in 1..8) {
        val loopMode = ApMode(false,Direction.FORWARD,length+2)
        val loopApp = LocalRelationApplication(ops,loopMode)
        val restriction = LoopOutputRestriction(ops)
        val base = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
        val original = ap.initial(f.pattern(base,tail=Tail.STAR,mark=MarkSlot.STAR))
        val firstScope = BlockScope(BlockId(2),PortId(20))
        val repeatScope = BlockScope(BlockId(2),PortId(80))
        fun row(input: List<Int>,output: List<Int>,scope: BlockScope) = Record(f.method,Direction.FORWARD,
            ap.initial(f.pattern(base,input,Tail.STAR,MarkSlot.STAR)),f.fact(base,output,Tail.STAR,MarkSlot.STAR),scope,PortId(80))
        val seedPath = List(length) { zero }
        val seed = row(seedPath,seedPath,firstScope)
        val repeatRows = (0 until length).map { k -> row(List(k) { one } + zero,List(k) { zero } + one,repeatScope) }
        val actual = f.fact(base,tail=Tail.STAR,mark=MarkSlot.STAR)
        val queue = ArrayDeque<Facts>()
        val store = FlowGroup(ap,ap.newInterners().flow)
        var observations = 0
        var attempts = 0
        var successfulApplications = 0
        fun apply(record: Record,input: Facts) {
            attempts++
            val out = Output()
            if (loopApp.applyRecord(input,original,record,out)) successfulApplications++
            check(out.targets.isEmpty() && out.requests.isEmpty())
            val geometry = ops.leaves(record.conclusion).single()
            check(!loopSummaryGrows(record.premise,geometry))
            for (value in out.data) ops.limit(value,loopMode.fieldLimit,object:ApOut {
                override fun result(fact: Facts) {
                    for (kept in restriction.restrict(false,record.premise,geometry,fact) {
                        observations++
                        LoopObservation<Unit>(emptySet(),emptySet(),emptySet())
                    }) {
                        check(kept.layer == Layer.DEMAND)
                        store.add(kept as FlowTree)?.let(queue::addLast)
                    }
                }
                override fun markRequest(mark:TaintMark) = error("No limit request")
            })
        }
        apply(seed,actual)
        var processed = 0
        while (queue.isNotEmpty()) {
            val input = queue.removeFirst()
            processed++
            for (record in repeatRows) apply(record,input)
            check(processed <= (1 shl length))
        }
        val finalPaths = store.all().flatMap { ops.leaves(it) }.map { it.fact.path }.toSet()
        check(finalPaths.size == 1 shl length)
        check(finalPaths.all { it.size == length })
        check(observations == 0)
        closureCases += linkedMapOf("storedMaxDepth" to length,"currentFieldLimit" to loopMode.fieldLimit,
            "normalRows" to length+1,"firstEntryScope" to firstScope.toString(),"repeatScope" to repeatScope.toString(),
            "initialActual" to desc(actual),"seedRecordPremisePath" to seedPath,
            "repeatRule" to "1^k 0 -> 0^k 1, k=0..L-1; equal stored prefix lengths; known suffix retained",
            "nativeAttempts" to attempts,"nativeSuccessfulApplications" to successfulApplications,
            "freshCompletionPackets" to processed,"finalDistinctDepthLPaths" to finalPaths.size,
            "loopConsumerObservations" to observations,"allStoredRowsNonGrowing" to true)
    }
    println(json(linkedMapOf("state" to "PASS","runtimeRevision" to "52f32dd437d438aec4a700a02c18d94c31d58093",
        "groupingControls" to controls,"widthMechanismControls" to closureCases,
        "limits" to listOf("Native AP and loop restriction controls only; no analyzer or code-under-analysis run",
            "The width construction uses distinct genuine first-entry/repeat record scopes; it does not claim actual Stirling/Conductor implements a binary counter",
            "The seed increases known actual prefix from0 to stored depthL via ancestor STAR inside despite equal stored geometry",
            "A single equal-length row is insufficient for exponential depth; this construction has O(L) rows and2^L fixed-depth paths",
            "Grouping proof preserves outside-cell at/below applications; actual replay must retain both growth strata"))))
}

data.ownerIsolation: Each complete collection is grouped independently; no cross-wrapper key equality assumed.
data.scope: nonzero nonstatic NORMAL FLOW native record objects; preserve producer direction, full P, exact scope/exit and full output header; do not drop any output positions

separateRecordDeltaObjectCensus.distinction: This groups historical delta OBJECTS by full header, not the many output POSITIONS inside each packed object. 1165→1021 objects is only12.36%; it is not the reader-position grouping opportunity.

analysis.starInsideMechanism: A strict ancestor FLOW STAR can lose suffix correlation and produce an ANY/DEMAND result at the entire stored output prefix. Stored equal-length geometry bypasses loop restriction despite the actual known-prefix increase. This is a mechanism, not an actual-project attribution.
analysis.widthControlScope: One deep first-entry NORMAL seed row and L equal-length NORMAL rewrite rows at a DISTINCT repeat scope. Current global limit is L+2; stored depth is L. Native AP + ordinary global limit + selected LoopOutputRestriction + FlowGroup completion dedup enumerate2^L distinct depth-L paths with0consumer observations. No code-under-analysis/driver run inferred these artificial inventories.
analysis.firstEligibleCell: Later-run plain nonzero FLOW scalar strict-ancestor reverse applications only; exact mode, owner, ports, old complete native premise, caller original and projected full E/mx/layer fixed. Native witness selection must retain exclusion/mark checks.
analysis.observerVsBody: Pure LoopConsumerObservation goes from adjacent saved DATA directly to enclosing C5 without per-row loop growth classification; actual loop-body replay must preserve both growth strata, because identical AP results can be gated differently.
analysis.outsideCell: Retain at-path and below-reader applications (reader premise path is a prefix of the actual path) individually. Concrete STAR, MAY/MUST cases established by current report counterexamples cannot be disabled globally. No need for ancestor FLOW STAR has been proved or disproved in isolation.
analysis.impactLimit: Four-to-one is a native transfer-result opportunity within one eligible hypothetical query. Snapshot widths do not establish a global eligible event fraction or predicted wall-time improvement.
